# MCC Island Event Helper

[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?labelColor=black&color=grey&label=&query=title&url=https://api.modrinth.com/v2/project/XoGpyaiR&style=flat&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcc-island-event-helper)
[![Modrinth](https://img.shields.io/badge/dynamic/json?labelColor=black&color=grey&label=&suffix=%20downloads&query=downloads&url=https://api.modrinth.com/v2/project/XoGpyaiR&style=flat&logo=data:image/png;base64,)](https://modrinth.com/mod/mcc-island-event-helper)

> A quality of life mod for MCC Island that provides useful features for limited time events

---

### Requirements
- Minecraft 26.1 or higher
- [Fabric API](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-api)
- [Fabric Language Kotlin](https://modrinth.com/mod/fabric-language-kotlin)
- [Yet Another Config Lib (YACL)](https://modrinth.com/mod/yacl)
- (optional) [Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu) to easily access the config screen

---

## Features

This mod provides the following features for MCC Island events:

### Sea Monsters (2026):
- Displays the location heart icon of the Event Fish next to the fish's name in the "Order screen".

### Cursed Carnival (Halloween 2026):
- Adds a widget that shows the current number of Ticket Scrap the player has in their Infinibag, and how many tickets they could craft with it.
- Adds a widget that shows the time remaining until the next Hub Activity.

The mod can be configured in the "Mods" menu or by running the `/eventhelper` command.
